annotations.title: Get the organization's usage across all numbers

description:
Get message and contact usage for the whole organization.

The top-level totals are the **sum across every live number**: an
organization with two numbers on a 50,000-message plan reports a quota
of 100,000, not 50,000. The `numbers[]` breakdown shows each number
separately, which is what you need to find the one that is close to its
own ceiling, so a healthy-looking total can hide a number at 99%.

For one number, `get_message_quota` and `get_contact_quota` are more
direct.
name: get_usage
title: Get the organization's usage across all numbers
